storage.limits: Whole-partition block counters may include unrelated I/O; sector unit is512bytes. Read-ms counters and engine I/O waits are not additive wall time. O_DIRECT open flags do not prove every read avoided fallback.

failed_candidates.kernel_observation: Inspected window showed SVM/KFD workqueue CPU-hog warnings, no observed GPU reset/OOM/NVMe error. This does not diagnose root cause.

limits: Three samples per task are not statistical significance.
Native PP differs from SSE TTFT/decode and startup load time.
Shared fresh prompt target uses Qwen tokenizer; actual Maya token counts are retained.
Independent starts use identical expert seeds, while OS/page/expert caches evolve.
Whole-run and per-request thermal coverage are separate. Sampled peaks are not transient maxima.
SMU flags alone do not quantify throttling duration or speed loss.
Core parity passed; broad DS4 failures and compatibility setting remain explicit.
No production promotion is inferred from a candidate-only result.
